title: Lookout Mountain Laboratory as Manhattan Project film lab

tellings.quote: But now that more information is being released, we learn that it was the film labs for the Manhattan Engineering Project.

related.note: Both are lore about the same Lookout Mountain facility in Laurel Canyon. This telling makes it the Manhattan Project's film lab in the 1940s, while the story makes it a CIA facility.

plain: A facility on Lookout Mountain in Laurel Canyon, Los Angeles, was the film laboratory for the Manhattan Project, the wartime effort to build the atomic bomb. The researcher Paul Schatzkin says this on the show, saying it has come out as more information is released, though he names no source. If so, the site had a secret military role long before its later reputation.
